\log_{k+1}2 &= \frac{ \log_2\left(\frac{k+1}{k}\right)}{\log_2 k \log_2 (k+1)} \\ &=
\frac{\log_2(k+1) - \log_2 k}{\log_2 k \log_2 (k+1)} \\ &= \frac{1}{\log_2 k} -
\frac{1}{\log_2 (k+1)}. \end{aligned}\]Therefore, the sum telescopes: \[\begin{aligned}
\sum_{k=2}^{63} \log_2\left(1 + \frac{1}{k}\right) \log_k 2 \log_{k+1} 2 &=
\left(\frac{1}{\log_2 2} - \frac{1}{\log_2 3}\right) + \left(\frac{1}{\log_2 3} -
\frac1{\log_2 4}\right) + \dots + \left(\frac{1}{\log_2 63} - \frac{1}{\log_2 64}\right)
\\ &= \frac{1}{\log_2 2} - \frac{1}{\log_2 64} \\ &= 1 - \frac16 \\ &= \boxed{\frac56}.
\end{aligned}\]
